title: Prevent disclaimer-only finalization on read-only chat retrieval
description: Read-only retrieval prompts can finalize with only a structured-write disclaimer and no answer body. Add a response-assembly guard so read-only completions must include a non-empty answer payload before disclaimer wrappers are appended.
acceptanceCriteria: Read-only retrieval prompts always include a non-empty answer body when the turn reaches assistant finalization.
Structured-write disclaimers are appended only when relevant and never replace the requested answer content.
Regression tests cover the provider-architecture single-source prompt shape and fail if output is disclaimer-only.
Trace or debug logs identify whether a final answer body was present before wrapper augmentation.
validation: Run targeted chat-agent tests covering read-only retrieval wrapper assembly.
Replay local-profile prompt: 'Use wiki search and return the single best source for chat tool catalog provider architecture.' and verify answer includes a source sentence plus reference section.
Confirm JSON/task parsing succeeds for the new task record.
